parsed.scene_description: An indoor retail aisle with glass-door refrigerated units on the left and open shelving on the right. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from a black ceiling with fluorescent fixtures. The floor is reflective tile. Aisles lead to additional refrigerators in the background.

objects.label: refrigerated display unit
objects.observation: Large glass-door unit on left wall, filled with beverages and snacks on multiple shelves. White interior lighting visible. Red signage above with Chinese characters.

objects.label: hot air balloon decoration
objects.observation: Blue and white striped paper lantern hanging from ceiling. Appears suspended by thin string or wire.

objects.label: wire shelving unit
objects.observation: Metal grid-style shelf holding packaged goods. Multiple levels with products like snacks and drinks.

objects.label: packaged bread
objects.observation: Loaf of bread in clear plastic packaging on top shelf of right-side unit. White bag with red text.

objects.label: bottled water
objects.observation: Clear plastic bottles with pink caps on lower shelf of right-side unit. Arranged in rows.
